purpose: Contract keys that do not resolve to an exported flow definition, accepted as the state on 2026-09-15. This list may only shrink.
why: GOV-06. The exported definitions and the tenant register share no identifier — docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/registers/flow-definition-map.json records idOverlap: 0 — so the two corpora are joined on normalised display name, which the map itself calls evidence rather than proof. A key lands here when no exported definition carries a name the register recognises for the workflow that serves it. That is a gap in what this repository holds, not proof the flow is missing from the tenant.
howToRemove: Export the flow from the tenant into docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/contracts/deployed/ under the name the register knows, run npm run reconcile:definitions, then delete the row. The row must go in the same commit: a key that resolves while still listed here fails this test.
doNotAddToPass: A new row means a definition stopped resolving. Find out why — usually a rename on one side of a display-name join — rather than recording the loss.
remedyInFlight: DGO_HTTPFlowRegistry.WorkflowId (Text, indexed) was added to docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/registers/http-flow-registry-spec.json on 2026-09-10 to close GOV-06 blocker 1. It is not yet provisioned to any tenant. Once a registry row carries both identifiers, this join stops depending on display names and this baseline can be retired rather than shrunk.
